query_analysis.original_query: Our PSA system is showing inefficient cycling due to delays in valve actuation. What control upgrades would you recommend to optimize adsorption/desorption timing?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Investigate and propose control system improvements for a Pressure Swing Adsorption (PSA) system to minimize valve actuation delays and enhance overall cycling efficiency

communication_strategy.information_flow: Sequential performance diagnostics and control strategy development

clarification_questions: What is the current cycle time of your PSA system?
Can you provide details about the specific valve types and current control mechanism?
What is the target improvement in cycling efficiency?
